vibe: High-end penthouse atmosphere, modern elegance, luxury interior design magazine style. Think Restoration Hardware × Cartier × a modern art gallery.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento 'Tetris' Grid for visuals, asymmetric editorial columns for storytelling. Generous whitespace is critical.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Optical alignment, heavy use of negative space. Avoid center-everything. Left-align dense text.

surfaces_and_borders.cards: bg-[#121212] border border-white/5 hover:border-white/20 transition-colors duration-300

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Text colors must explicitly change or brighten. Buttons lift (-translate-y-1) with subtle glow shadow.
motion_and_interaction.scroll: Native smooth scrolling or Lenis for momentum scrolling.
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Fade up and staggered reveals for list items.

components_instructions.hero: Cinematic full-bleed image/video. Max bg-black/40 overlay. Expressive serif heading. Strong CTA.
components_instructions.product_viewer: Interactive gallery with zoom capability. Split layout: Image on left (sticky), details on right.
components_instructions.customizer: Interactive color swatches updating the main image or a subtle glowing element. Use Shadcn Tabs or Radio Group deeply customized.
components_instructions.cart: Shadcn Sheet component. Styled with dark background, 1px white/10 borders, elegant typography.
components_instructions.checkout_modal: Shadcn Dialog. Clean, high-trust simulated payment UI (Stripe/Razorpay look) with dark styling.
components_instructions.reviews: Masonry grid or horizontal scroll. Dark cards, 5-star gold icons, authentic-looking text and photos.
components_instructions.b2b_portal: Structured form using Shadcn Input/Select/Form. Elegant floating labels or stark minimalist inputs with bottom borders only.
components_instructions.footer: Darkest background (#000000). Huge typography for brand name (text-[8vw] Cormorant Garamond), sparse links, tracked-out text.

testing.attributes: Must include data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, swatches, cart toggles, etc).

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a luxury e-commerce SPA. NEVER use placeholder images. Use ONLY the URLs provided in the media section.
Implement an asymmetrical, text-rich layout with overlapping layers. Adhere strictly to the spacing and container_padding rules.
The hero image must feature a cinematic overlay (bg-black/40) with expressive serif typography (Cormorant Garamond). Do not center-align everything.
Use Framer Motion to animate the product showcase, Customizer, and reviews.
Shadcn components must be highly customized. Limit rounded corners to achieve a sharper luxury magazine aesthetic. Inject 1px glassmorphism borders for cards/panels instead of standard solid borders.
The shopping cart must be a Shadcn Sheet with dark styling, and the checkout modal must be a simulated payment UI built with Shadcn Dialog.
Ensure the 'data-testid' attribute is added to every interactive element for automated testing.
Do NOT use generic fonts like Space Grotesk or Inter. Use 'Cormorant Garamond' for headings and 'Outfit' for body text.
Provide installation command for required font packages (e.g., from Google Fonts) and icon packages like lucide-react.
